Directions: Park at trail head on Rt. 627. Plot 400 m up trail and 50 m in.
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood canopy with high seedling cover in understory.

Directions: park in parking lot off of wilson road.Take trail 900m. At fork take right  100m.
Location_Notes: All trees tagged away from trail, toward BR. 2014 - changed orientation to 215 from 222.

Directions: Parked on park road south of large observation tower. Walked 100 m to plot.
Location_Notes: Oak canopy, some regen.

Directions: Park at amphitheater loop, walk in on trail.
Location_Notes: Oak hickory canopy, microstegium, ribes, and seedlings make up most of ground cover.

Directions: Park at eternal peace flame monument-plot just off of road
Location_Notes: Oak hickory canopy, with microstegium and rosa in understory.  Lots of rosa, tox, ribes and lonicera in plot.

Directions: take Wheatfield road to Ayres Ave, follow most of the way around to pull off before reaching Wheatfield road, hike along road and then in about 60m
Location_Notes: NA

Directions: Road from elementary school behind tobacco barn
Location_Notes: club moss dominates understory; Nys syl possibly confused with oxydendrun arboreum - corrected in 2016. Orientation was recorded as 303 in 2008

Directions: Park in suburbia at head of horseshoe trail
Location_Notes: changed orientation from 305 to 290.

Directions: Park at the MARA baseball and softball fields. About 400 m from parking lot. Walk to back of park and across bridge to residential area, then into woods.
Location_Notes: Lots of invasive shrubs and herbaceous ground cover. Open canopy.

Directions: Take River trail down about 1km, plot about 20m NE from trail. Trail is drivable, not advisable in a wet year when muddy. No key needed.
Location_Notes: Decent slope on rocky embankment (levy?) with trail at top and trail close to bottom.

Directions: Good pull off at River Ridge Rd for parking. Walk 600m down trail, plot ~50m from trail.
Location_Notes: NA

Directions: 290m @ 155 degrees from NC memorial Parking Lot
Location_Notes: Short Ace rub, Lir tul, Pin vir canopy. Smilax thicket

Directions: Park along Visitor Center road.
Location_Notes: Plot has several boulders, looks to be old quarry site.  Plot orientation changed from 254 to 252 in 2013.

Directions: Park in field off Gordan road. About 500m to plot, easier to walk through forest than field.
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood canopy, microstegium, ferns, and herb undrstory. Humulus (hops) on plot, herbaceous vine, record as herb.Perennial stream runs through plot.

Directions: From visitor's center take dirt road to Administration office. Take left at 1st intersection. Go toward small stream with wooden bridge and cross bridge. Go through unlatched gate. Take right at first intersection after gate. Follow road until it dead ends in parking lot for residence. (2022 recommendation) from visitor's center, take 345 heading South and turn right onto gravel road. You should pass some historical homes and eventually each a small parking lot. 50m walk from around hopewell furnace boarding house.
Location_Notes: Center Tag?

Directions: Take hiking trail to the south from Confederate rd.  Bushwack about 100m.
Location_Notes: Near health cut, southern half of plot in sapling regen age.

Directions: Park at either Anthony Wayne statue (horse) and walk 300m through field to forested area, or park along 252 at trail head and take trail into forest to plot.
Location_Notes: Center Tag #1149

Directions: Park at Pennsylvania monument.
Location_Notes: Swamp white oak overstory (some health cut) with rubus, lon jap,  rosa, shrubs and tall seedling, becoming sapling understory. Bee sting. Deer trail 1-5%.
mixed hardwood canopy with thick barberry and lindera understory. Difficult to shoot angles due to thick understory.

Directions: Park at the park gate in the residential neighborhood. Follow dirt trail that is parallel to bike trail until you reach a social bike trail on the right. Social trail takes you almost entire way to plot.
Location_Notes: cap for plot center was  missing but rebar is still in ground, added another piece of bent rebar with flagging. Found cap scattered on plot and put back into center. High microstegium, hard to locate stakes.

Directions: Park on Gordan road and walk across field to the forest; about 300m easy walking from Gordan rd.
Location_Notes: Two drainages at 5ft deep run to the right and left of plot center. Mostly leaf litter on ground with pine overstory and deciduous understory.

Directions: Park near employee housing and bushwack north about 350m
Location_Notes: plot has small creek bed running through bottom.  Not very shrubby. Changed orientation from 270 to 280.

Directions: Hike in from Rt. 345.  Parking spot across from Green lane, 380 m to plot. No where safe to park closer to plot.
Location_Notes: Vines and shrubs abound, spicebush, wineberry and bittersweet, oh my! Also, quite a lot of barberry now (2022).

Directions: Park at head of Horseshoe trail in suburbia and walk in. plot is an easy 200m bushwalk down slope of trail.
Location_Notes: slopey plot with tall lir tul canopy and not much in understory.

Directions: Hike up Horseshoe trail and cut in at 263 degrees and 50m.
Location_Notes: Mountain laurel understory with mixed oak canopy. 2013- changed orientation from 180 to 177.

Directions: Park on West Confederate Ave just north of Emmitsburg Rd in parking spaces next to Arkansas monument, walk in on hiking trail then cut in 20m to plot.
Location_Notes: Oak hickory canopy, large canopy gap due to huge df Q. alba. Oak seedlings, rosa multi, lon jap, and mile-a-minute responding. UL micro in tip-up mound.

Directions: Drive to Betzwood Parking lot, continue along parking lot until you see bikre trail ramp on right.  Enter bike trail carefully using a spotter and make a left.  Drive slowly along bike trail, past plot and park off the bike path near clearing.about 300 meters past plot. Or hike from the east bike parking lot about 1.2km.
Location_Notes: Plot moved 20M N due to paved bike trail. Orientation changed from 55 to 50 7/24/14. BR is under log, reset bottom micro. Steep slope on part plot, slippery

Directions: Take Gordon drive from main park road and follow around curve. Park by driveway 896 (dirt road) and walk in approx 300m. Once you get through initial shrubs into the forest, easy walking through open understory
Location_Notes: Pinus taeda and Liriodendron tulipifera overstory, Quercus rubra, Acer rubrum, Carya midstory. Low ground cover and open understory

Directions: Park at RM office (85m from plot).
Location_Notes: changed orientation from 360 to 350.  Right next to road and trail.  Very wet plot.  Lots of shrubs and very difficult to find rebar as well as stakes. Dry in 2022 but a very dry year in general.

Directions: Access from East Confederate Ave.
Location_Notes: Oak-mixed hardwood slope with dense understory. Possible health cut, big bucked log down in plot.

Directions: Park on Confederate ave in parking spaces. Hike in on trail, plot just off trail.
Location_Notes: In a health cut, very dense with very tall rubus allegheniensis. Tough plot, best to have more than 2 crew members. 2019 - not the worst plot, rubus covers less than half the plot. Could be improving. 2024 - Subcanopy Cercis has grown in densely, plot is now decently shaded but canopy gap still not closed. Plot has improved, doable with a 2 person crew.

Directions: Parked on side of one-way road (West Line). Walked ~100 meters over ridge to plot.
Location_Notes: Betula lenta canopy, open subcanopy. Mostly mic vim ground cover.

Directions: Good pull out off of River Ridge Rd, walk about 170m down trail. Walk south along Union cavalry trail and cut in at about 30m from plot.
Location_Notes: Very dense regen, sparse ground cover. Center cap very loose on rebar.

Directions: Drive down park road and take left fork at field. Drive down to the maintenance area and park in the shade. Should be about 300m from the plot.
Location_Notes: Quercus phellos/ Pinus taeda canopy, mixed hardwood subcanopy. Some seedlings and sedge groundcover.

Directions: Near Indiana monument.
Location_Notes: Very open plot, with small temp stream. Rosa and vib pru make parts of plot dense.2016 -Had to reset plot center using trees (again). Placed a fiberglass stack and rebar at the base of 3139 and a rebar 5m meters away at 74 degrees. If you strap out a tape between the two new stakes, plot center should be at 2.25m from tree 3139 and 3.75m from the other stake on the other side of the stream. Plot center is marked by a thin rebar (no center cap) and a white stake but we anticipate it being washed out again as it is in a temporary stream bed. BR is just sticking out from under a log. 2022: plot center is now marked by two center stakes and a thin piece of rebar. Hopefully at least one will remain.

Directions:
Park in field, walk in approximately 250 meters.

*Note: Some stumps around plot.
Location_Notes: Virginia Pine and mixed hardwood canopy with sparse understory.

Directions: Park in trailhead parking lot off of Hopewell rd; follow Lenape trail until roughly 160m away.
Location_Notes: Rocky forest floor with lots of moss and mixed hardwoods. Loose rocks on plot, try not to do in rain. Good amount of ToxRad. 2014- evidence of fire: charred logs and burn scars on some trees.

Directions: Park at first parking lot on the right as you enter the park. Walk across field and then 300m through forest with pathchy dense smilax to plot.
Location_Notes: Young mixed hardwood forest in a smilax thicket. Smilax is quite dense in parts of the plot.

Directions: Park at the intersection of Sykes and wheatfield.
Location_Notes: Dense saplings w/ oaks make up canopy. Park at the intersection of Sykes and wheatfield.

Directions: Park at General Sterling's house. Walk the left side of the field and find social trail. Cross stream and follow social trail until you are 40 m from plot.
Location_Notes: Changed orientation from 345 to 350. Quercus canopy with a sparse understory.

Directions: Take Slocum Ave, park 50m from plot at 2nd Maryland momument.
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood canopy, dense fraxinus sapling regen.

Directions: Park on trail.  Hike approximately 70 m at 50. Plot on slope.  Plot upslope from Jack-o-Lantern trail and brook
Location_Notes: Lir tul/loblolly successional with lots of nyssa sylvatica. 2014 - changed orientation from 280 to 272

Directions: Park on road just south of creek bridge, then bushwack east about 300m.  Cross small creek.  No wellies needed.
Location_Notes: Microstegeum groundcover with some barberry; seems to be becoming more barberry and rosa than microstegium over time (2024).  Red maple floodplain.

Directions: Park at General Grant headquaters parking lot. Walked 450m on road side and bushwacked for 70m. Possibility of parking at cemetery with shorter roadside walk.
Location_Notes: Short Que phellos and beech canopy, sparse understory. Old road bed runs through plot. UTM E value corrected, mjj.

Directions: park at trail crossing inner line road. Trail gets within 60m of plot
Location_Notes: Mixed harwood canopy with Rhododendron maximum in understory. MicVim and RubPho taking up much of the plot (RubPho 1/4)

Directions: Park on Green Ln and hike in about 250 m
Location_Notes: Red oak canopy with Nyssa and Sassafras in understory. Vaccinium ground cover. 2015- changed orientation from 360 to 2 degrees. Microplots were mixed up in 2007.  Saplings recorded in UL were actually in B, and saplings recorded in UR were actually in UL.

Directions: Park on Inner Line Drive.  Plot 15m away
Location_Notes: Tulip poplar overstory, wine berry treatment since 2022 as understory.

Directions: Park on Loop Rd. off of Wheatfield Rd. and walk 20 meters uphill.
Location_Notes: Lots of vib pru in understory, oak hickory canopy

Directions: Drive across field and park on road, 130 m from plot at picnic area graveyard.
Location_Notes: White oak canopy with white oak regeneration in understory. 2014 - changed orientation to 110 from 115.

Directions: Drive along Forest Rd until no longer passable, about 450m from plot. Walk rd until about 90m from plot then cross stream and bushwhack. 2018 - difficult time finding plot: coordinates were about 30m away from plot center. Not sure if coordinates are off or if our GPS accuracy was. Alternate coordinates: 0696078, 4139859. 2023: updated plot coords to 2018 coords.
Location_Notes: Very dense plot lots of privet, symphocarpus , and rubus likely has water on plot in spring. Full crew recommended. 2014 - changed orientation from 360 to 3 degrees

Directions: Park on River Ridge Rd 450m from plot. Hike on trail then bushwhack 130m through sucessional hardwoods. Club moss thick on forest floor
Location_Notes: NA

Directions: Leaving the Visitor Center area, take a left and drive north along Shed Road. Take the first right and park at the trailhead parking area on the left. The trail/gated fire road will be across the road. Walk along the trail for approx 1km (take Lenape fork). Plot will be approx 70 m off the trail on the left.
Location_Notes: NA

Directions: Park at yellow house (resource management) walk across field and go through gate in upper right corner, follow stream/deer trails to plot 160m.
Location_Notes: Dense barbery thicket with open canopy. Appears to be seasonally flooded but is dry in July. However, stakes seem to often be disturbed. Dense mid-layer, plot is decently shaded given low canopy cover. Replacement center cap needed

Directions: 2018 VAFO REGEN: Park by the Kennedy-Supplee restaurant and walk towards the bridge over the river. As you approach the river, there will be a gate in the chain link fence. Enter there, and walk the trail or on the edge of the forest where it meets the train tracks to the plot. It is a long walk.
Location_Notes: Tree of Heaven and microstegeum and stinging nettle plot.  Semi-open .B microplot and UL were marked with a fiberglass stake. 2018 VAFO REGEN: Wellies needed in a wet year.

Directions: Bushwack in from Rt. 122. Or 780m from brush pile off road to park housing. Easy bushwacking.
Location_Notes: Pinus virginiana canopy, wth mixed hardwood in understory. Fairly open.

Directions: Drive down service road. Ask if you can drive on trail past junction. If not, park at junction.
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood canopy with Carpinus midstory and lycopodium ground cover. 2013- changed orientation to 341 from 331. Has a lot of shade, even if deemed an open plot.

Directions: Park at French Shed parking lot, take trail to about ~150m away.
Location_Notes: NA

Directions: Park at Culp's Hill parkling lot and walk back to intersection. Plot is 30m off the road.
Location_Notes: Oak/Hickory sparse canopy with thick understory of Rosa multiflora and rubus with fair amount of regen. Four person crew recommended. 2022: plot has inexplicably improved. Four crew members no longer necessary.

Directions: Park on grass road, walk in about 80 m.
Location_Notes: Dense hardwood regeneration, lots of small saplings. Understory sparse. Orientation changed to 3 (previously 360)

Directions: Park at veterns memorial parking lot. Plot just down trail
Location_Notes:
Mic vim with tall tulip poplar canopy. 
2022 - lots of shrubs coming in: Rosa, Rubus, and Viburnum. Some stinging nettle on left side of plot.

Directions: Close to plot 9.Either walk from plot 9 about 300 m through forest or drive to end of Gordon Drive, park in the grass, walk in 150m
Location_Notes: Pinus, oak overstory with Beech regen. Mostly open with dense patch of saplings and trees near BL

Directions: Turn on gravel road off of Pawlings road, head towards Pawling Farm. Park on side of road and walk about 200m west across field
Location_Notes: Tulip poplar canopy with stiltgrass understory… little else.

Directions: Park on Green Ln, plot just off the road.
Location_Notes: Oak/hickory canopy. Some barberry and rosa but not a lot yet.

Directions:
Park on a main road through GEWA. Plot approx. 30 m from road.

WARNING: HuGe HolE (over 1 ft deep and wide)! Near upper left regen. Two crew members fell into hole. Thankfully, limber crew avoided significant injury. Future visitors may not be so lucky.

Plot moved 20 m north due to proximity of road and mowed area.
Location_Notes: PINTAE canopy, some LIQSTY, ilex opaca subcanopy, vitis ground cover. Lots of tox rad vines on trees

Directions: Drive on dirt road past visitor's center. Then, drive margin of field to within about 90 m of plot.
Location_Notes: liriodendron dominated; ravine through plot

Directions: Walk on field past cemetary continue on the gravel road through forest. Plot is just off the road on left.
Location_Notes: Successional Tulip poplar. Stream bed/flood zone through center of plot. Dry in 2016

Directions: Walk down path towards cemetary.  Plot approximately 75m left of cemetary.
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood, lots of herbacous cover. Edge forest: invasives, shrubs and vines. Wet muddy patch, semi-permanent stream in plot, consider bringing boots epsecially if a wet yearr. UL corner in 1.5m above ground in recent tip up. No rebar, will have to be reset when tip up mound disintergrates.

Directions: From paved road walk south 50m plot adjacent to trail near marsh
Location_Notes: loblolly and mixed hardwood; large downed virginia pine in plot; trail directly adjacent to plot; BR stake under large CWD; no white stake at UL, only rebar due to proximity to trail

Directions: Turn onto Foxwood Road and follow along into the eastern section of the park. Park in the pullout before the duckweed pond about 120m before the plot, then walk down road to plot, which is only about 30 m from the road.
Location_Notes: Coordinates changed in 2015 to correct location. Old loblolly pine plantation/juniperus virginia. Sparse ground cover. Chiggers can be bad, take appropriate precautions. Changed orienation to 5 from 360.

Directions: Park at the Visitor Center and walk behind it to the streambed (it was dry on our visit, likely ephemeral) and follow to the plot. Or find your way to the cemetary, plot is in the woods just behind it.
Location_Notes: Dry stream bed. Microstegium covering 25-50% of plot. Large canopy gap, mixed hardwood canopy.

Directions: Walk South from visitor center ~800m.  Plot on a slope, ~20m from power line cut.
Location_Notes: Sparse mic vem and sedge understory, Asimina and Ilex mid, mixed hardwood canopy

Directions: Hike past little house and through small field, down slope.
Location_Notes: lots of spicebush, some sycamore not too tall.  Bottom half of plot transitions to terrace with large tulip poplars

Directions: Park on access rd.  Enter from north end of park.  Walk approx. 200 m NW.  Plot located on north side of creek bank.
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood canopy, Ilex opaca midstory, bare understory. Fence runs through BR of plot.

Directions: park on road along park boundary. Plot about 230 m from road. Plot at bottom of ravine, across ditch/stream canal. Or hike in from VC (500ish meters). Take trail to second field them hike through forest (easy bushwack but steep ravines at times.
Location_Notes: moderate slope with Tulip poplar canopy and New York fern understory.  Changed plot orientation from 192 to 194 degrees to better reflect plot layout (2013).

Directions: Southward direction behind Tenant House
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood on slope with stream bed at bottom of plot; pawpaw midstory and large patches of microstegium in understory; both BR and B micro stakes are in or near streambed

Directions: Park near restroom and waterfront. Walk-in on trail.
Location_Notes: Oak and Pine canopy with Ilex understory, sparse ground cover on most of plot. Part of plot has dense Microstegium and overhanging vines.

Directions: Park near maintenance.
Location_Notes: Plot right on side of rouad about 150m from maintenance buildings, road almost in plot.  Japanese stilt grass and smilax understory. A bit open, not much.

Directions: Park on road after road to picnic area. 160 m to plot
Location_Notes: Mature PINTAE in canopy with mixed hardwood underneath. Sparse ground cover. Changed plot orientation from 360 to 346.

Directions: Park on Rd to picnic area. Bushwack 50m to plot.
Location_Notes: Loblolly canopy, fairly open. Dense ground cover off new york fern, microstegium, and false nettle (boehmeria cylindrica).

Directions: Park at the far end of the French Encampment Area, head into woods about 200 meters. Tagged with number 5821.
Location_Notes: Mixed forest with dense sapling regeneration.

Directions: Park along park road heading towards French Encampments. Head south/southwest approximately 180 meters into forest.
Location_Notes: Mixed forest overstory; plot located in moderate gap allowing pine regeneration on forest floor.

Directions: Park along park road to French Encampment loop, enter woods on right; plot is approximately 30 meters from road.
Location_Notes: Mixed woods forest with minimal understory.  Originally recorded as GRTS point 80, but GRTS point 29 is the correct GRTS value for the sampled plot.

Directions: Park on tour rd, less than 100m easy bushwack in. If tour road is gated, there is a pull off on the other side of cook rd, easy 600m hike from there.
Location_Notes: Center Tag #17989. Steep ravine through middle of plot, BL transect crosses it. Mixed hardwood canopy with ilex in the subcanopy. Sparse groundcover.

Directions: Park along park road (towards French Encampments). Follow mowed area along margin of the field until about 120 meters from plot.
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood forest with Asimina triloba understory.

Directions: Stop at pull off on right side of road and walk peninsula of upland between 2 marshy areas to plot.
Location_Notes: center stake tagged with 15833.

Directions: Park on Colonial Parkway, about 200m from plot. Plot center marked with tag # 14383.
Location_Notes: Loblolly/Tulip Poplar canopy, Carpinus subcanopy, sparse ground cover.

Directions: Parking at pull out by cemetary. Walk back along road to powerline M2334 TL14. You should be about 50m from the plot. Cut in an look for a break in the smilax and paw paw. The plot is immediately behind the dense edge.
Location_Notes: Center tag14030. Plot on a slope. Good amount of paw paw understory, some smilax not much else. Lir tul and liq sty canopy. BL stake offset at 11m to avoid deep wash.

Directions: Fark off third pullout after Wormley pond.  Head west about 250m.
Location_Notes: Tulip poplar/Loblolly woods.  Sparse understory.

Directions: park on Goosely Rd, plot about 100m from road. Or park on French Encampment loop and walk 400m.
Location_Notes: mostly Pinus taeda canopy, also liriodendron and sycamore; dense asimina triloba midstory. Plot ID-tag is 14647

Directions: Park on tour rd where you would for plot 354.  Hike North, for about 200m along small ridge of upland, then NW to plot another 600m or so.  Do not need boots, dry the whole way.
Location_Notes: Some loblolly pine regen, partial canopy gap as well..

Directions: park on road (french encampment loop) walk about 275 m to plot from road. Plot center marked with tree tag # 15697.
Location_Notes: loblolly pine and mixed hardwood, vaccinium understory

Directions: park on Surrender Rd, plot 95m fromn road, follow earthworks from road leading straight to plot
Location_Notes: plot id tag 14785; flat, dry mixed hardwoods with very sparse understory

Directions: Park on Tour Rd, walk in about 100m. Plot tag # 14881.
Location_Notes: Loblolly/Tulip Poplar canopy, paw paw regen.

Directions: Park along side of parkway, then hike in about 450m passing over a couple of small ravines.
Location_Notes:
Plot is in a small ravine.  Steepish slopes with some large CWD.  Plot aspect is down slope of ravine. Lots of large trees just outside of the plot. 
2022: plot center tag is #18554.

Directions: Park in pullout northeast of the plot (along the tour road). Hike along forested highground for aprox. 1km.
Location_Notes: Oak/Loblolly pine forest adjacent to tidal marsh. Yellow jacket nest encoutered on upper ceter line at ~9m.

Directions: Park on Battlefield tour rd. walk north about 100m.
Location_Notes: Pinus taeda canopy with red maple coming in. sparse understory. Not as open as crown closure indicates, subcanopy provides shade. Center tag #12810

Directions: Park on tour rd, walk in about 350 m. Do not walk old road/trail east of plot unless a very dry year: it is normally very wet and very buggy. The straight bushwhack is easy walking. Plot center marked with tag # 14758.
Location_Notes: White oak canopy, ilex sub canopy, sparse groundcover.

Directions: Park on Surrender Field Rd. Walk in  along forest rd and then bushwack to plot.
Location_Notes: Center Tag #12348, Pinus taeda canopy, Ilex subcanopy.

Directions: Park on tour rd, plot is just off the road.
Location_Notes: Center tag #12328. Pinus taeda canopy, smilax and morella in understory but mostly open. 2019 - took new GPS coordinates. Old coordinates E 344600, N 4118550

Directions: Park at the turn out nearest the plot and walk back along the road before cutting into dense pine saplings.
Location_Notes: Center Tag #40

Directions: Park at end of field 315m from plot and walk edge. Small stream crossing to get to plot. Crossable on a downed tree but boots may be helpful. Plot tag # 14701, 371 sharpie'd on back.
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood canopy, paw paw understory. Not much ground cover.

Directions: Park on tour road at Lincoln (officer) sign pullout, walk in <300m. 2019 took new GPS coordinates (old coord: E367850, N4119300)
Location_Notes: Center tag #12347. Plot is on what looks to be an old road bed. Microstegium covers most of the plot. Mixed hardwood canopy. Steep ravine drops off south of plot.

Directions: Park on One Way tour road reached from Surrender Rd.  Plot is about 60m east of road.
Location_Notes: A bit of a thicket with pawpaw and privet with sweet gum and pine overstory.  UR corner stake is set under large log.  Trees were mapped with compass and sonin.

Directions: Park at Washington's Headquarters loop. Take trail to the left of the two parking spots. At first intersection turn right , continue along trail. Turn right onto park boundary fire road. Plot is on the right. Plot center marked with tree tag number 15692.
Location_Notes: Lobolly pine and mixed hardwood canopy with sparse understory.

Directions: We walked over from plot 377 to avoid the river and wetland between plot 378 and the tour road. Walk due West from plot 377 to hit old forest road, walk road until 80m from plot, then cut in. Or take old forest road from tour road. Plot marked with tag # 14761.
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood canopy, ilex subcanopy, sparse ground cover. Decent amount of cwd. UTM E value corrected, mjj.

Directions: Park on tour rd, right before forest. Plot is 90m from the road.
Location_Notes: Center Tag #13195. Pinus taeda canopy, mixed hardwood midstory, sparse subcanoy and groundcover.

Directions: From Colonial parkway, walk SW to floodplain, about 90m.
Location_Notes: low-flow stream running through plot.  A bit mucky throughout. Bring boots, particularly in a wet year.

Directions: Park on Goosley Rd. There is a pullout near the cemetary which is a little farther from the plot but is safer. Than walk down Goosley rd, walk to end of field and then cut into woods.
Location_Notes: Center Tag 15119. Paw paw seedlings as groundcover, mixed hardwood and pinus taeda canopy.

Directions: Park on historical tour road in pull-out just after the field and interp sign. Walk down road about 50 m to join social trail. Follow social trail for about 400m, then turn West, plot is about 125m west of social trail.
Location_Notes: Center Tag #1149. Center tag not located but stake was located 8/6/19. Center tag # now 12260. Pine and Tulip poplar overstory with Prunus serotina and Liriodendron tulipifera midstory. Ilex opaca subacnopy with low ground cover

Directions: Access French Loop from Surrender Field, park at fire road after field and walk about 600m down fire road, 50m off fire road (right side)
Location_Notes: loblolly pine and red maple dominated; temporary stream through plot (possibly permanent?) 2017 - visited plot after heavy rain, stream very full. Center stake tagged with tree tag #19275.

Directions: Park on Goosly Rd and walk 60m to plot. Or park in housing development
Location_Notes: Sycamore, sweet gum, and tulip poplar canopy with paw paw understory. Stream runs through plot. Much evidence of flooding in 2013.  A bunch of trash has also been deposited with the flooding.

Directions: Park on Historical Tour Drive on the west side of Beaver Dam Creek and walk along earthworks for about 400m.
Location_Notes: Open wet plot along Beaver Dam Creek tributary. Bring boots and sun protection.

Directions: Plot off Crawford Rd. Park at pull out 500m past plot. Walk back along road and cut into forest at 100m from plot. Plot center stake was missing, new tag number
Location_Notes:
Tulip poplar canopy with ferns in understory.  Interesting donut hole pit dug into the ground abouut 4m in diameter.
* Plot Marked as #356 in 2013, will need to update Tag to #357

Directions: Park at subdivision, hike in 200m or so. Park at the end of Alexia Lane, close to forest edge.  Follow social trail directly to plot.
Location_Notes: Decent amount of holly regeneration, bare herbaceous layer. Center stake has tag number 18576.

Directions: Park at pull out just after fork. Walk in 50m, plot just before wetland. Plot center tag # 14741.
Location_Notes: GRTS 26 original location did not work, rejected North and East alternates. Plot set at southern alternate location. Half of plot mostly shrub cover, other half Nyssa  and Pinus taeda, sparse canopy.

Directions: About 60m off tour rd.
Location_Notes: Microstegeum ground cover.  Some large fallen tulip poplars

Directions: Park on French Encampment Loop and walk about 400m at 95 degree bearing to plot
Location_Notes: Quercus canopy with sparse understory and Ilex midstory

Directions: Follow park road towards Wormley Pond. Plot is off the left side of the road up a steep incline.Tag at center 15062
Location_Notes: Ilex/Oxydendron understory - zilch in the herbaceous layer.

Directions: Park on Park Loop rd, plot is 15m south of rd
Location_Notes: loblolly pine regeneration, large red oak dominated canopy; directly adjacent to marsh (plot is in narrow strip of forest between marsh and loop road). Plot id tag is 14619

Directions: Park on tour road and walk 160 meters to plot.
Location_Notes: Mixed hardwood canopy with dense Asimina triloba sapling understory. Sparse ground cover. Plot center marked with tree tag #13499. 361 is written on the back in sharpie.

Directions: Park on Cook Rd and bushwhack 80 m to plot. Plot center marked with white stake and tree tag # 14812.
Location_Notes: Plot very close to the road and borders on a small clearing. The upper half of the plot is dense Asi tri regen, the bottom half of the plot is on a slope. Trash heap in plot. Tree sized ligustrum on plot. A lot of broken glass on plot.

Directions: Park on tour road and walk 65m to plot. Plot center marked with tree tag number 16634.
Location_Notes: Sweet gum canopy with very shrubby Myrica mid and understory; adjacent to marsh

Directions: Park on tour road at pullout 70 m from plot. 2019 - found GPS coordinates 18m off. Plot is on N slope of ravine.
Location_Notes: Center Tag #12395. Plot on a slope. Good canopy coverage by trees outside of plot. Mostly subcanopy trees on plot. Open midstory and ground cover. Trees tagged away from road.

Directions: Park at fire road at boundary of park and Newport News Rec. park off of Crawford Rd.  Hike north on fire road about 200m, then head east to plot about 120m.
Location_Notes: Oak canopy with holly midstory and sparse understory.

Directions: NO DIRECTIONS ENTERED YET
Location_Notes: Center Tag #18303

Directions: park on surrender field rd. walk done forest road, cut in about 400m
Location_Notes: Center Tag #12394. mixed hardwood and pinus taeda canopy, some mic vim for ground cover.

Directions: Easy access from green run campsite, 50m
Location_Notes: Mixed forest of holly, sassafras, and pine. Green briar, vitis understory.

Directions: Park between KM marker 27 and 28, find a pony trail and follow it across the dunes and through the forest. About 800m to plot from edge of beach.
Location_Notes: Carex, vitis, and smilax understory with morella mid-story and Pinus virginiana overstory. Some shade but openings in canopy.

Directions: Park at Pine Tree campground and walk 100 meters through Smilax rotundifolia.
Location_Notes: Pinus taeda overstory with Smilax and Vitis understory and Morella cerifera midstory

Directions: Head to KM 33, take road toward Pope Bay campground past gate. Head North from road where forest opens up with sandy substrate. Easy walking about 400m.
Location_Notes: Pinus taeda overstory with sand and pine duff substrate. Sunny, open site.

Directions: Take dune crossing at KM 23.5 and park at end of road. Walk West around 'the gut' (wetland and small stream complex). You must go around the standing water, and the route is more circuitous than it may appear. Proceed into Pinus taeda forest 50m. May be able to access plot via kayak.
Location_Notes: Very open Pinus taeda dominated stand with Smilax understory. BRING KNEE BOOTS, plenty of water for this site.

Directions: Park at 27-28km on beach and walk in attempting to find a pony path to cut through brush
Location_Notes: Pinus taeda overstory and morella cerifera understory. TOX RAD ON 32/47 TREES. IN EVERY QUAD. SAVE YOURSELVES. (bring gloves and technu)

Directions: Park past km marker 27.  From beach try to walk across the sand and avoid shrubs; use horse trails whenever possible.  Good luck. Will need someone with machete or tool to cut shrubbery back on bushwhack in.
Location_Notes: Pine overstory with Morella, Vaccinium, and poison ivy in understory. Lots of poison ivy on trees, bring ivyx/tecnu.

Directions: Park on beach perpendicular to plot; follow sand as much as possible to plot.
Location_Notes: Pinus taeda in overstory. Acer rubrum, Vaccinium, and Smilax in understory. Some Vaccinium dieback observed in the understory.

Directions: Park past Km 29.  Hike on old road all the way to plot, plot is just off road. Coordinates for the road: (38.0751399, -75.2102562)
Location_Notes: Pinus taeda overstory, Morella cerifera, Smilax and poison ivy mid/understory. Bring poison ivy wipes/tecnu. Dense PIN TAE regeneration in open sections. Prickly pear just off plot!

Directions: Follow hunting trail to marsh, then walk along marsh until you enter forest.
Location_Notes: Pinus taeda understory; grassy with Smilax in understory.

Directions: ~70m from ASIS 392.
Location_Notes: Plot is located partially in an old horse exclosure. BL and UL are outside deer exclosure. Canopy opening with PIN TAE regeneration in BL of plot. Pinus taeda overstory with grass, Morella, and Smilax understory. Horse skull in plot.

Directions: Take hunting trail at km 26.3 into marsh and walk the edge of marsh to plot. Hunting trail is marked with posts. Over 1km hike.
Location_Notes: Pinus overstory with Smilax and Diospyrose understory.

Directions: Park km 32, road is at km 32.9 and park on side of road into campsite (Pope's run). Walk on sandy patches south of the parking area in arcing path.
Location_Notes: Plot is a pine forest, upper right of plot has some shrubs.

Directions: Park at Km 29 and change. Take road to about 70m from plot.
Location_Notes: Pine forest with heavy smilax midstory and pretty herbaceous ground cover.

Directions: Park at Km 31.9. Follow the old road bed indicated on the topo map to the Clemets boathouse. Head south at the forest edge and walk the sandy patched until heading west to the plot. Head west (take left) at 18s 480129 4212080.
Location_Notes: Pine forest with MorCer midstory and understory of pine needles and Poaceae. Some plot corners are a little wet.

Directions: Park in the South Beach parking lot and take hunting trail (Blind 2) until you reach a large amelanchier tree and turn left.
Location_Notes: Open plot very shrubby. A lot of SmiRot and MorCer with Rubus mixed in. Canopy is Pinus Taeda.

Directions: Park at Km 26.5. Used distance sampling transect the entire walk to plot. Once we got to the marsh we went south to plot.
Location_Notes: Pine overstory with MorCer midstory and pine regen/pine needles in understory.

Directions: Very close to plot 401. Park at Km 26.5. Used distance sampling transect the entire walk to plot. Once we got to the marsh we went south to plot.
Location_Notes: If doing 401 and 402 in the same day, go to 402 first. Center is very shrubby with a lot of SmiRot. Plot around center is slightly less shrubby.Pinus canopy with MorCer VacCor SmiRot midstory and pine needle understory.

Directions: Park at overwash fan just north of km 32, follow horse trail west along the Deep Water Gut, head south into forest
Location_Notes: Short pine overstory with base, pine needle understory

Directions: Park at Green Run Campground and take trail to cemetary, 60m south past the cemetary.
Location_Notes: Pine overstory with poaceae and vitis understory. Plot on mound, there is slope and microtopography.

Directions: Park at km 22.2. Follow sandy area as far as you can go, go towards the pond and then search for the horse trails that lead you back to the old road. Follow road west until you get close to the bay then follow it straight south.
Location_Notes: Pinus overstory with smilax understory; not too dense, looks like deer are keeping the smilax down.

Directions: Take life of the forest trail, plot is 20m north of trail
Location_Notes: NA

Directions: Park at Area 18 hunt blind near km 26, take hunt trail to marsh, head south to forest, follow forest/shrub line westuntil able to access interior
Location_Notes: Pinus Taeda overstory with grasses and pinus seedlings in understory

Directions: Take hunting road to area 12, park before getting to end of road
Location_Notes: Pinus taeda overstory, pine needle and sand understory. Pretty open plot, sunny.

Directions: Take loop nature trail (north side) right to plot (about 10 m away).
Location_Notes: Moderate shrub understory, tulip poplar canopy. Many downed trees. Very wormy soil.

Directions: Take trail behind museum; Bear right at fork; Follow for about 270 meters; Cut in to the right about 50 meters; Plot located in valley between two small ridges
Location_Notes: Oddly open, lots of tox rad as ground cover. Mixed hardwood canopy.

Directions: Walk on loop trail behind museum; Plot is about 45 meters to right of trail (after fork)
Location_Notes: Changed plot orientation from 360 to 4 deg. (2013).  Fairly open canopy from recently dead trees.  Moderately dense understory of shrubs and vines.

Directions: Plot about 50 meters North from driveway to SAHI parking lot -OR- Plot about 200 meters from parking lot
Location_Notes: BR is offset 1m (13.1m from center at 178 degrees) due to tree. Bmicro is 7m ay 320 degrees (instead of 323).
